manual: The models come from the local model engine: install community-apps/omarchy-local-ai/install.sh first (Podman). Only the music model (ACE-Step) has been run on Omaxian; image and video models are untested.
Add-a-picture uses the xdg-desktop-portal FileChooser; install a portal backend (xdg-desktop-portal-gtk).
Hyprland monitor sizing is skipped without HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE, so the default 1344x768 target is used on i3.
Audio and video go through Qt Multimedia's FFmpeg backend.
